# TestScript for 10-builtins-help-version
# Asserts HelpCommand and VersionCommand built-ins, plus help enrichment via
# the Examples/HelpFooter builders and the Description/Examples subcommand methods

# 1. Normal command execution
exec builtins-help-version status -d
stdout '⚙  builtins-help-version status'
stdout 'builtins-help-version · root'
stdout 'status · active'
stdout 'status\s+command\s+—\s+▸ selected'
stdout '-d, --detailed\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --detailed'

# 2. Flag --version (single-line summary)
exec builtins-help-version --version
stdout 'builtins-help-version has version 2\.4\.1 built with go'

# 3. Subcommand `version` (docker-style multi-line manifest)
exec builtins-help-version version
stdout 'builtins-help-version:'
stdout 'Version:\s+2\.4\.1'
stdout 'Go version:\s+go'
stdout 'OS/Arch:'

# 4. Subcommand `version --json` (machine-readable object)
exec builtins-help-version version --json
stdout '"version":"2\.4\.1"'
stdout '"goVersion":"go'
stdout '"modified":false'

# 5. Subcommand `help` (root help: description, examples, footer)
exec builtins-help-version help
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'builtins-help-version <command>'
stdout 'Commands:'
stdout 'status'
stdout 'help'
stdout 'version'
stdout 'Examples:'
stdout '  builtins-help-version status$'
stdout '  builtins-help-version help status$'
stdout 'builtins-help-version home: https://example\.com/builtins-help-version'

# 6. Subcommand `help status` (Description and Examples methods enrich the screen)
exec builtins-help-version help status
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'builtins-help-version status \[flags\]'
stdout 'Reports the health of every subsystem builtins-help-version manages\.'
stdout 'Flags:'
stdout '-d, --detailed\s+Show detailed subsystem diagnostics'
stdout 'Examples:'
stdout '  builtins-help-version status$'
stdout '  builtins-help-version status --detailed$'

# 7. Subcommand `help nonexistent`
exit-status 2 builtins-help-version help nonexistent
stderr 'unknown command: nonexistent$'

# 8. Invalid flag with UsageHint mode
exit-status 2 builtins-help-version status --unknown
stderr 'unknown flag: --unknown'
stderr 'Run ''builtins-help-version status --help'' for more information'

# 9. Custom commands rendering through the session primitives
exec builtins-help-version guide
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'builtins-help-version guide'

exec builtins-help-version syntax
stderr 'Usage:'
stderr 'builtins-help-version syntax'

exec builtins-help-version about
stdout 'builtins-help-version has version 2\.4\.1'

# 10. Invalid --json value is a usage error
exit-status 2 builtins-help-version version --json=banana
stderr 'invalid boolean value "banana"'

# 11. Configured built-in short flags (app.HelpShortFlag/app.VersionShortFlag)
exec builtins-help-version -h
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'builtins-help-version <command>'
stdout '-h, --help'
stdout '-V, --version'

exec builtins-help-version -V
stdout 'builtins-help-version has version 2\.4\.1 built with go'

exec builtins-help-version status -h
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'builtins-help-version status \[flags\]'
stdout '-h, --help'
